reviews.comment: Do not be scared by the rate my professor rating. Emily Blum is a super sweet and caring professor. If you put in the effort and pay attention in class getting an A is very achievable. No matter what this is going to be a difficult course with difficult exams.

She gives good feedback on quizzes and only keeps ur top 8 scores. Gives practice problems for exams that somewhat help, but recommend doing textbook problems. Lectures are helpful if your paying attention, but don't rely solely on them. It's a tough course so prepare to study a lot, but she provides plenty of help and is very nice!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: As long as you go to class and maintain a decent understanding of all the material tested over up until each unit exam, an A should be achievable. I left two days to study for the tests and it felt okay, would recommend starting sooner.

Sadly my experience was pretty poor, I reached out for help several times and felt like the response was to seem like she was trying to help me when in fact it was simply to redirect me and others so her class average stayed where she wanted it. I do have concerns about her actually wanting to teach students.

Sweet professor who's open to feedback. The class is tough, but not because of her. She gives helpful study materials—textbook problems, extra MCQs with video solutions and in-class practice problems. Lectures are useful if you pay attention. Attendance isn't required, but I'd still recommend going!

Most students don't enjoy taking Blum's course because it requires you to pay attention and attend class. Her lectures ARE hard to understand and follow if you're on snapchat or skip class (like ~50% of our class.)
This class builds on a lot of other accounting ideas. If you paid attention in previous courses, and will pay attention, Blum is great.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet and genuine. She is honest and open with students and seeks to develop a personal relationship with all of them. Lectures are not as helpful as they could be. Prepare to spend a lot of time reading and teaching yourself to master the content. Tests are pretty difficult but she curves a good amount. If u struggled with 229, don't take her

Blum is a sweet prof, but her lectures in my opinion do not prepare you for the exams. The homework helps a lot to learn the material. There are not many practice problems to study with at all. I'd recommend a different prof if accounting is not your strongsuit

ACCT 327 is already hard and taking this prof is like doing it in hardcore mode. I would say skip class and read the textbook on your own because that is 95% of what is covered in class but she has in-class quizzes. Overall if you are an avid self-teacher, looking for a challenge, and want to dedicate all your spare time to this class take Blum.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Her teaching style is not effective, notes have answers already given and you rarely work through a problem in class. Homework & exams will have multiple questions that aren't covered in class, and honestly, the textbook hardly helps in that case. Things will seem simple but will be way harder than she makes it seem- you're very much on your own!

Blum is not the worst prof I've had, but her teaching methods are not super effective. In class, she'll go over slides with the answers already given. Weekly quizzes aren't too bad but IMO to properly learn in this class you should get a tutor right away! The homework is usually hard, and some questions/topics won't be covered in class.

Emily Blum is a terrible professor for 327. Her lectures contribute no knowledge towards the tests given. She expects you to have knowledge of things she doesn't even cover in class. She often times puts things on tests that she never went over in class. When preparing for exams she provides no help besides telling you to read the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Blum is a great teacher.  She will go above and beyond with seeing students outside of class.  I learned a ton from her.  So glad I took her course.

Hardest class I have ever taken in Mays. She puts material on the exams that you have never seen, and she doesn't give clear study guides or practice problems for exams. Attendance is mandatory as she gives pop quizzes. Her lectures never made any sense.I  was always confused.  DO NOT TAKE HER

This professor had no teaching ability and makes it impossible for students to understand the material. I do not recommend this professor at all. DO NOT TAKE HER. Her test question are ridiculous, and she just reads the textbook in class and it dosent make any sense.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am a junior and she is by far the worst professor I have ever had. She is condescending and blames her students for not performing well on her exams. On her tests, she incorporates material that we have never been taught. Her exam 2 class average was a 54%........ don't take Blum, take anyone but her!

All she does is talk about how she isn't going to finish lessons after spending 10 minutes on what she did the past weekend. Her lectures are just reading off the textbook. She doesn't provide much help for homework or good examples and her exams are extremely difficult even if you did the practice tests. Don't take her if you have other choices.

The ineffective teaching style of Professor Blum and her exams made this the hardest class this semester. Even after reading the textbook and completing practice problems, the exams were extremely difficult as they were very different from the practice tests.  If Blum is the only available option, consider taking 327 another semester

This is really just a HARD class. It is hard to get feedback because of the nature of the content. The thing about the way her section was taught is what we learn in class is way easier than the homework, especially the difficulty of the exams. She gives bonuses and curves but it just isn't enough. Take Larkin.

Wouldn't recommend taking her. Take Larkin instead if you want an actual prof that provides resources for students to practice with. Her style of teaching is meh, go to class and watch her slide show that you won't have access to until the next week when you no longer need it because you already took that chapter quiz. Just don't take Blum.
